accountId.description: The account this query result belongs to.

queryState.description: Opaque state string for this query. Pass to Email/queryChanges to detect changes to the result set.

canCalculateChanges.description: Whether Email/queryChanges is supported for this query.

position.description: Zero-based index of the first ID in the full result list.

ids.description: EmailIds of the results for this page, in the requested sort order.

total.description: Total number of matching emails. Only present when calculateTotal was true.

limit.description: The limit applied by the server (may be lower than the requested limit).

anchor.description: The anchor EmailId used for this page, if anchor-based pagination was requested.

pageToken.description: Opaque cursor for the next page of results. null or absent means this is the last page. See https://specs.serverlessinbox.com/page-token
